notes.title: Playtest Update!
notes.content:
📢 New Playtest Update is Live!

We’ve been working hard to improve your gameplay experience and add exciting updates. Here’s what’s new and fixed:
    •    New challenge at the port – test your skills!
    •    Improved keybinding for keyboards, controllers (including PS5), and steering wheels (including Moza).
    •    Fixed teleport to the start of challenges.
    •    Slightly lowered default graphics settings to improve FPS.
    •    Potential fixes for graphical glitches, including setting default AA to TAA.
    •    Adjusted physics settings to perform better at low FPS (below 35).
    •    Slower camera rotation behind the car.
    •    Added challenge restarts, improved challenge visibility/hiding, and scrollable results for long lists.
    •    Increased max replay time to 90 seconds.
    •    Fixed assignment of steering wheels and controllers.
    •    Fixed loading/saving of various controller settings, including dead zones.
    •    Improved Force Feedback functionality for Moza steering wheels.
    •    Fixed drift bar display when driving in reverse.
    •    Localization now works correctly in the build.
    •    DLSS and AA settings now save properly.
    •    Added working camera settings.
    •    Added Landscape Quality to graphics settings.
    •    DLSS option now grays out if unsupported.

Thank you for your feedback – it helps us refine the game! 🚗💨
